UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Director or creator account profile synced per authenticated user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this profile.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

VideoProject.title: VideoProject
VideoProject.description: A video production project containing ordered shots and production status.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this project.

title.description: Project title (e.g., YouTube Ep. 1, Short Film).

createdAtMillis.description: Client creation timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

updatedAtMillis.description: Client modification timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ShotItem.title: ShotItem
ShotItem.description: An individual shot entry inside a video production project.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this shot.

shotNumber.description: Shot label or number (e.g., Scene 1 - Shot 1).

sortOrder.description: Zero-based display and filming sequence order.

shotType.description: Cinematography preset or custom shot type name.

visualDescription.description: Camera movement, framing, and visual action description.

vfxNotes.description: Transitions, overlays, color grading, or CGI notes.

sfxMusicNotes.description: Background music cues, ambient sounds, and sound effects.

isCompleted.description: Whether this shot has been filmed on set.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: Video production projects owned by the user.

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}/sho.description: Sequential shots belonging to a user's video production project.
